annotations.title: Create iMessage contact profile picture upload

description:
Create iMessage contact profile picture upload

Creates a 10-minute presigned upload for a JPEG, PNG, or WebP profile picture of at most 5 MiB and 4096 pixels per side, bound to the line's active iMessage ability period. Works in every mode and changes nothing. Send the file as multipart/form-data to uploadUrl with every form field, without Photon credentials, then commit it with commitImessageContactProfilePicture. Requires platforms:write bound to the path project.

API reference: https://photon.codes/docs/beta/api-reference/imessage/create-imessage-contact-profile-picture-upload
name: createImessageContactProfilePictureUpload
title: Create iMessage contact profile picture upload
